stem: After administering a vaccine covered by the Vaccine Information Statement requirements, which documentation set is required by federal VIS instructions?

options.A: Administration date, vaccine manufacturer and lot number, name/address/title of the person who administered it, VIS edition date, and date the VIS was given
options.B: Only the client's first name and room number
options.C: Only the vaccine brand; lot number and VIS information are never documented
options.D: Only the date of the next appointment

rationale: CDC's current VIS instructions list specific documentation elements for covered vaccines, including administration date, manufacturer and lot number, administrator information, VIS edition date, and date the VIS was provided.
educational_objective: Document federally required VIS and vaccine-administration information.
source_organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
source_document_title: Instructions for Using Vaccine Information Statements
source_locator: Recordkeeping requirements: administration date; manufacturer/lot; administrator name/address/title; VIS edition date; date VIS provided
source_claim_supported: Federal VIS instructions require documentation of vaccine administration details and the VIS edition/date provided.
blueprint_source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
blueprint_locator: Health Promotion and Maintenance, printed p.9/PDF p.13
blueprint_topic: Health Promotion and Maintenance — immunization documentation
correction_summary: Rebuilt the item around the complete federally required documentation set rather than a partial vaccine-record list.
